main_text.l: EXERC. XLV.
DE ARTHRITIDIS CON-
TINENTE causa.
QVum de arthritidis ratione & essen-
tia ab aliis medicis nō diffentit Fer-
nelius, nihil in huius affectibus de-
finitione immorabimur, sed statim ad con-
tinentem eius causam progrediemur. Hac
autem esse uariam ipse pernegat libro Pa-
thologiae, de Partium morbis & sympto-
matis. Neq;(inquit) humor hic continens
„arthritidis causa tam uarius, atq; traditur,
existit. Nec enim sanguineus, nec biliosus,
nec melancholicus unquam est, sed omni-
nō uel pituitosus, uel serosus. Perperamq;
arthritidis differentiae ex humoris genere
statui soleat, ut alia calida, alia frigida fit,
sed omnis frigida est ex frigido humore ge-
nita. Hæc Fernelius quibus non solùm cae-
terorum omnium medicorum, tum vete-
rum, tum recentiorum authoritati & iudi-
cio, atq; etiam ipsi rationi, & experientiæ (ex quibus universa constat medicina) sed
& sibi ipsi ex diametro repugnat, quemad-
modum consequentibus patet. Si(inquit)
rubor, aut calor interdū, maximeq; in chi-ragra,

page.notes: The first line reads "diffentit" as printed; the letters are slightly unclear at this scan resolution. The "nō" and "omni-nō" forms follow the printed macron. The quotation marks „ at the start of lines are printed quotation marks and are kept. The mark after „ in "„arthritidis" is a small printed mark, kept as printed. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The line "ragra," continues "in chi-" and is text, not a catchword.
